$comment: Documented npm audit exceptions for the postcard subproject only. Read by scripts/audit-with-exceptions.cjs in the 'Full dependency audit (postcard)' CI job. Each entry excuses exactly one advisory ID; every other high or critical advisory still fails the job. An entry stops applying the day after its reviewBy date, which fails the job until it is reviewed. See SECURITY_COMPATIBILITY.md.

exceptions.reviewWhen: Genkit supports Zod 4, or 2027-02-05, whichever comes first.
exceptions.reason: Genkit 1.x and OpenAI 4.x require Zod 3, and no patched Zod 3.x release exists (the advisory affects zod <4.6.6). Forcing Zod 4.6.7 through an override breaks 2 of the 10 postcard tests because it changes Genkit's schema API and JSON-schema translation.
